Research desk: all four items are handled.
(1) The T3 correction is relayed to L-N3. T3 is now judged against 8 under the permutation-chain definition, and the 'judge against 13' instruction is withdrawn in the same message.
(2) Part 2/2 of CLAUDE-SIX-ORBIT-PROOFS.txt is relayed verbatim to chat-4ac4b34cf7 under the header 'part 2/2'. The message is about 3.9k characters. I spot-checked System 3: every exclusion cites an adjacent row (j±1), and the dead row P2 R⁺{0,1,5} is correctly killed by 1,5∈P1 and 0∈P3.
(3) I asked L-N2 to print the sha256 values in model_check.py's output, or to provide a .txt copy of SHA256SUMS. I did not request the extensionless file.
(4) L-N1 certificates: I cannot glob paths, so I asked chat-8cf5afe743 for the exact list of .ultramath/smwh3vfw7/m1/cert_orbit_*.json with sha256 values. I will download up to 6 per cycle once the list arrives. Until then the certificate check in ln1_referee.py stays vacuous, as you noted.
Lean: the queue is idle. I queued StepBanShort-r2 on the R1 pinned environment. The r2 file passed my review: the label-level decide covers 625 cases, Finset.not_subset/disjoint_left are used as structured steps, and there is no sorry. I am HOLDING ConsumerContracts.lean. It uses `𝓝`, `Tendsto` and `atTop` without `open Filter Topology`; `𝓝` is scoped Topology notation, so the file cannot parse as written. It also assumes WeakColoring/fourSupport/direction resolve from namespace `OAI` rather than `OAI.EuclideanFiveColor`. Its owner should add `open Filter Topology MeasureTheory` and qualify the names or open the namespace. See needs_parent.
Note: L-R1 has now reproduced '16 of 3840, 90 each' with the gauge fixed at α₀=0, and it matches the graph lane entry for entry. Per the plan, item (d) still needs an explicit field point per cell before it is banked.
summary: No global chromatic improvement. Six-orbit proofs are now fully relayed to L-N3; T3 J-depth target is 8 (permutation-chain). L-R1 independently reproduces 16/3840×90 with the corrected gauge; graph lane also has 1440=120×12=16×90 consistent. L-N1 coordinator reports 18 dihedral orbits, 13 generic + 5 degenerate realised; the certificates are pending download. L-N2: m2 accepted with a K_{3,3} parity observation (no k=6 analogue of the odd-cycle engine); the converse collapse⇒(N) is still open; C9 successor is queued until smwh3jqqn ends. L-N4: 116 certificates pass the coordinator's checker; the 7-chromatic claim is under audit, so nothing is banked yet. Lean: 139 passed / 25 failed, queue idle; StepBanShort-r2 queued; ConsumerContracts held for missing opens.
needs_parent: ConsumerContracts.lean (download-6) is HELD and not queued.
